prompt:
You maintain a running summary of a long engineering document that is being read part by part, so that a later reader can model the system in SysML v2 without seeing the earlier parts.
Update the summary with the new part. Keep, as compactly as possible: the full names of system elements, actors and items; every alias or call sign with the full name it stands for; which element produces, sends or receives which item; modes and normative requirements. At most 300 words.

Current summary:
Boundary: receiving to outbound load release. Elements: Inbound Inspection Desk (Cinderbay): checks paperwork/trailer ID/seals, records damage; sends Trailer Seal Exception Note to Yard Gate Controller (Velvetrook: validates arrivals, assigns lane/door, holds risky vehicles; in recovery holds vehicles outside boundary); consumes Oversize Load Advisory. Pallet Dimension Scanner (Moonquarry) checks profiles against limits, produces Oversize Load Advisory. Inbound Pallet Buffer: staging only. North/South Aisle Stacker Cranes; North (Juniperwake) sends Aisle Occupancy Snapshot, uses Slot Reservation Receipt, reports faults, verifies aisle clear before resuming. South crane does reduced-speed recovery maneuver. East/West Transfer Conveyors; East restarts empty at reduced speed one cycle before pallets (record: authorization, speed, cycle result, alarm response). Conveyor Line Controller (Brasshaven) produces Transfer Induction Ticket, sent to Autonomous Forklift Fleet (Larkspur: validates destination vs route; produces Forklift Handoff Confirmation). Brasshaven inhibits feed if restart incomplete/protective device changes, holds transfers into isolated area. Outbound Dispatch Sorter receives Dispatch Wave Amendment. Outbound Checkweigh Scale produces Gross Weight Variance Slip; reference-load check at shift start and after maintenance. Shipping Documentation Desk. Safety Zone Controller applies Sprinkler Zone Inhibit Notice (from Fire Alarm Panel) by maintaining exclusion boundary until release; both may always stop movement. Maintenance Release Terminal (Copperfield) produces Crane Service Release Card; status checked before return to automatic. Warehouse Management System (Morrowglass): authoritative; sends Dispatch Wave Amendment; produces Slot Reservation Receipt; receives snapshot; records transaction times, reconciles vs shift plan; presents recovery plan. Actors: Warehouse Operations Supervisor (verifies personnel clear, reconciles holds before release; shift-start review of alarms/equipment/unresolved work; confirms operators know speed limits, boundaries, stop criteria; compares downtime vs event records, investigates differences); spotter; drivers, receiving, yard, maintenance staff. Modes: Normal; Recovery (position discrepancy, obstruction, alarm); staged resumption observed. Requirements: valid receipt; segregate damaged pallets; dimensional exceptions held; stale snapshot holds path; no move without WMS release; faulted crane unavailable; personnel outside envelope; unexpected event → stop; boundary removed only after test pass and clear aisle; safety checks (detection, warnings, e-stops) before production; boundary visible and enforced; weight variance reweigh; near

New part:
S217: At handover, the outgoing shift records equipment restrictions, pending checks, and unresolved safety concerns.
S218: The incoming shift acknowledges those conditions before authorizing routine movements.
S219: Commissioning acceptance is conducted against an approved test plan before routine warehouse operation begins.
S220: The test plan defines expected behavior, safety limits, evidence requirements, and criteria for blocking release.
S221: Each subsystem is exercised under representative loads, including recovery from interrupted transactions and controlled equipment stops.
S222: The Warehouse Operations Supervisor confirms that acceptance evidence is complete and that any remaining limitations are documented.
S223: The Warehouse Management System is checked for inventory accuracy, transaction integrity, and correct handling of unavailable storage locations.
S224: Acceptance is withheld when a material defect could compromise personnel safety, inventory control, or shipment accuracy.
S225: The Warehouse Management System uses the handoff confirmation to close the applicable movement record.
S226: The Shipping Documentation Desk receives and reconciles the Gross Weight Variance Slip against the applicable shipment record before completing its paperwork.
S227: A scale variance outside the approved tolerance is investigated and resolved before the affected shipment is released.
S228: The North Aisle Stacker Crane accepts the release card as authorization to return to service after its checks are complete.
S229: A crane remains unavailable for automated assignments until its functional checks and required safety checks have passed.
S230: Morrowglass closes the commissioning action register only after unresolved findings have named owners and due dates.
S231: Cinderbay records governance approval and confirms that the accepted operating configuration is under change control.
S232: Brasshaven verifies that conveyor zones are clear and records the completion of its assigned closing checks.
S233: Larkspur parks its vehicles in approved locations and reports any remaining equipment restrictions for the next shift.
S234: Copperfield records completed service work and confirms that equipment restrictions remain visible until formally cleared.
S235: The Fire Alarm Panel is checked for active faults, bypasses, and indications requiring escalation before the facility is released.
S236: The Safety Zone Controller is verified against the approved access boundaries and stop-response behavior.
S237: The Inbound Inspection Desk and Outbound Dispatch Sorter confirm that their operating interfaces are available and that exceptions can be held safely.
S238: Changes to software, equipment settings, or operating procedures require an impact review, approval, and a controlled implementation record.
S239: Emergency changes are documented promptly and reviewed by the Warehouse Operations Supervisor before normal operation resumes.

Return JSON {"summary": "..."}.
